raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation Issue #39700. Developed based on #40177. Currently megamoe cannot be enabled on decode node on dsv4.1. ## Modifications 1. In _run_mega_routed, use vision_topk to apply ViT bias to image tokens, so that megamoe will not be restricted for language-only deployment. ## Accuracy Tests ## Speed Tests and Profiling With this PR, E2E and Output throughput achieves **10% improvements**. | Setup | TTFT / TPOT (ms) | E2E (ms) | Output throughput (token/s) | |--------------|------------------|----------|-----------------------------| | DP Baseline | 8912 / 2.30 | 10061 | 4440.26 | | With this pr | 8297 / 1.70 | 9144 | 4841.68 | DP attention baseline DP attention with megamoe Launch command ``` # prefill CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 \ SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL=INTRA_NODE_NVLINK \ MC_INTRA_NVLINK=true \ MC_INTRANODE_NVLINK=true \ SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_ALL_CP_RANKS_TRANSFER=1 \ sglang serve --trust-remote-code --served-model-name llm --model-path ${MODEL_PATH} --tp 4 --ep 4 --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 --enable-deepseek-v4-fp4-indexer --enable-prefill-cp --cp-strategy interleave --chunked-prefill-size 16384 --max-prefill-tokens 16384 --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.1 --mem-fraction-static 0.8 --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --speculative-dspark-block-size 5 --enable-hierarchical-cache --hicache-ratio 2 --hicache-io-backend kernel --hicache-write-policy write_through --detokenizer-worker-num 8 --tokenizer-worker-num 8 --reasoning-parser auto --tool-call-parser auto --enable-strict-thinking --enable-cache-report --enable-metrics --disaggregation-mode prefill --disaggregation-transfer-backend mooncake --host ${ip} --port 9091 > prefill.log 2>&1 & # decode CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4,5,6,7 \ SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL=INTRA_NODE_NVLINK \ MC_INTRA_NVLINK=true \ MC_INTRANODE_NVLINK=true \ SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_ALL_CP_RANKS_TRANSFER=1 \ sglang serve --trust-remote-code --served-model-name llm --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash/ --tp 4 --ep 4 --dp 4 --enable-dp-attention --enable-dp-lm-head --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 --disaggregation-mode decode --disaggregation-transfer-backend mooncake --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --speculative-dspark-block-size 5 --enable-deepseek-v4-fp4-indexer --max-running-requests 256 --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.05 --mem-fraction-static 0.87 --detokenizer-worker-num 8 --tokenizer-worker-num 8 --reasoning-parser auto --tool-call-parser auto --enable-strict-thinking --dist-init-addr $d_ip0:5757 --nnodes ${D_NNODES} --node-rank ${di} --host ${ip} --port 9095 > decode.log 2>&1 & # benchmark python3 -m sglang.bench_serving --model deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --flush-cache --host "${HOST}" --port "${PORT}" --backend sglang --dataset-name generated-shared-prefix --dataset-path ShareGPT_V3_unfiltered_cleaned_split.json --num-prompts 512 --gsp-num-groups 1 --gsp-prompts-per-group 512 -gsp-system-prompt-len 61440 --gsp-question-len 4096 --gsp-output-len 500 --max-concurrency 96 --warmup-requests 10 > "benchmark.log" 2>&1 ``` ## Checklist - [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). ## Review and Merge Process 1. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers. 3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so. - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci` 4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :no_entry_sign: [Run #37913746240](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37913746240) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #37913745955](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37913745955) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #37913746159](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/37913746159)

@@ -255,20 +255,35 @@ def _run_mega_routed(
 
     if num_tokens > 0:
         router_logits = moe.gate(hidden_states, forward_batch=forward_batch)
-        topk_kwargs = {"input_ids": input_ids_global} if moe.is_hash else {}
-        topk_output = moe.topk(
-            hidden_states,
-            router_logits,
-            num_token_non_padded=(
-                forward_batch.moe_num_token_non_padded()
-                if forward_batch is not None
-                else None
-            ),
-            expert_location_dispatch_info=ExpertLocationDispatchInfo.init_new(
-                layer_id=moe.layer_id,
-            ),
-            **topk_kwargs,
+        num_token_non_padded = (
+            forward_batch.moe_num_token_non_padded()
+            if forward_batch is not None
+            else None
         )
+        if isinstance(
+            getattr(moe.gate, "e_score_correction_bias_vl", None), torch.Tensor
+        ):
+            # V4.1 uses a different correction bias for image-token rows. The
+            # MegaMoE transport consumes the same routed ids/weights as TopK.
+            from sglang.srt.multimodal.dsv41.vl_routing import vision_topk
+
+            topk_output = vision_topk(
+                moe,
+                router_logits,
+                input_ids_global,
+                num_token_non_padded=num_token_non_padded,
+            )
+        else:
+            topk_kwargs = {"input_ids": input_ids_global} if moe.is_hash else {}
+            topk_output = moe.topk(
+                hidden_states,
+                router_logits,
+                num_token_non_padded=num_token_non_padded,
+                expert_location_dispatch_info=ExpertLocationDispatchInfo.init_new(
+                    layer_id=moe.layer_id,
+                ),
+                **topk_kwargs,
+            )
         topk_ids = topk_output.topk_ids
         topk_weights = topk_output.topk_weights
     else:
